title: Disability Compensation Replacement Payments: Amount of the Replacement
content:
**Amount.** The replacement of a returned Disability Compensation monthly payment repeats the gross amount of the payment that came back. The gross of the payment that came back is the gross amount shown on the most recent returned-payment entry in the award's payment history. Amounts are added to the cent, and the replacement is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Worked illustration (hypothetical).** A monthly payment with a gross amount of 1435.02 for the entitlement month of April is returned by the Treasury because the account was closed. The replacement for April is 1435.02.

| Returned-payment entry shows | Replacement amount |
|---|---|
| Gross 1435.02 | 1435.02 |
| Gross 2102.15 | 2102.15 |
| Gross 552.47 | 552.47 |

**Precision.** The amount is stated in dollars and cents and is never rounded to the dollar; a gross of 795.84 is replaced at 795.84, not 796.00.
